messages:
leo: hey team, i'm leo, day 3 on runtime. following the build-from-source steps on ubuntu 22.04 with CUDA 12.2. link step fails with a weird cublasLt / ptx mismatch. any quick onboarding pointers? :wave:

tara: welcome! can you paste the exact error and outputs of `nvcc --version` and `nvidia-smi`? also whether you installed CUDA via runfile or apt package.

leo: paste of tail of the log:
```
ptxas fatal   : Unresolved extern function `_Z21cublasLtMatmulDescCreateP10cublasLt` referenced from module
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcublasLt.so.12: undefined reference to `cublasLtMatmulDescCreate'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
make: *** [runtime/libnative.so] Error 1
```

nvcc: Cuda compilation tools, release 12.2, V12.2.148
NVIDIA-SMI 525.85.12 Driver Version: 525.85.12 CUDA Version: 12.2
installed CUDA via nvidia runfile into /usr/local/cuda-12.2

henry: two quick suspects: 1) driver/runtime ABI mismatch (driver 525 may lack some newer cublasLt symbols expected by our build), or 2) the linker is picking up a wrong libcublasLt (e.g., distro package) that doesn't match the toolkit. run `ldconfig -p | grep cublasLt` and `readlink -f /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcublasLt.so*`.

leo: results:
```
ldconfig -p | grep cublasLt
	libcublasLt.so.12 (libc6,x86-64) => /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcublasLt.so.12
readlink -f /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcublasLt.so.12
/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcublasLt.so.12
```
but i also have /usr/local/cuda-12.2/lib64/libcublasLt.so.12. `echo $LD_LIBRARY_PATH` is empty.

tara: OK that matches the usual host contamination issue. On personal machines the distro libs sometimes land in /usr/lib and take precedence. Quick try: `export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-12.2/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH` then `make clean && make -j`. If the linker still resolves the wrong file, inspect `gcc -Wl,-verbose` during linking to see the exact search order.

leo: tried LD_LIBRARY_PATH and rebuild; same undefined symbol. i ran `strings /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcublasLt.so.12 | grep cublasLtMatmulDescCreate` and it doesn't show the symbol, whereas the cuda-12.2 one does.

henry: bingo  the distro lib is an older ABI. Two choices: 1) uninstall the distro cuda libs (e.g., `sudo apt purge nvidia-cuda-toolkit libnvidia-*`), 2) prefer the container for onboarding (`ghcr.io/redwood-inference/rt-dev:cuda12.2`), or 3) if you can't remove packages, build with an rpath so the binary picks /usr/local/cuda-12.2 at runtime: add `-Wl,-rpath,/usr/local/cuda-12.2/lib64` to LDFLAGS.

leo: i'm on a company loaner so not comfortable purging packages. can rpath be added just for local dev temporarily?

tara: yes, you can patch your local `make` invocation: `make LDFLAGS="-Wl,-rpath,/usr/local/cuda-12.2/lib64"` or set `LDFLAGS` in environment. For a quick test, `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` should've worked but some linkers pick system paths at link-time; rpath embeds the right path in the binary and avoids system conflicts. We'll add a short note to onboarding docs about using rpath if you can't change host libs.

tools-bot: CI Notice: branch leo/onboard-cublas - build failed on CI host due to missing NVIDIA hardware. Link: https://ci.redwood/example/5678

leo: thanks! i'll try the rpath trick and/or use the dev container if i hit more issues. tara / henry, can you point me to the onboarding checklist so i can update it with the steps i took?

tara: docs/runtime/runtime-setup.md is the source. runtime infra maintains it (cc @henry). if you open a tiny PR adding a note about rpath and the recommended driver matrix (we prefer 535+ for CI & prod), we'll merge and we can refer new hires to the container as the canonical onboarding flow. welcome aboard :)

leo: great, i'll open a PR after i verify rpath works. appreciate the speedy help! :thumbsup:
